add.k: Karen's younger brother in Fagan Corners
st: Kevin cancels Karen's college deferment, then burns Todd's trailer and dies when Karen crashes their car as they flee.

files.notes: Name said many times in 3x10 (springfieldspringfield s03e10). On screen only in 3x10 (Karen's past); mentioned elsewhere and in Born Again. Group: the family diner; the app already calls it Penny's Place (name not said in 3x10 dialogue, taken as shown on the diner).

add.k: A nurse at Metro-General who works beside Claire
st: Louisa runs the crowded ER and keeps the press off Castle's floor, then dies stepping in front of a Hand sword meant for Claire.

files.notes: Only 'Louisa' is said (Claire, 2x11: 'No! Louisa!'); the surname Delgado is never said in the transcripts, so n is Louisa. On screen 2x03, 2x06, 2x10, 2x11 per wiki. Her 2x03 and 2x06 lines are not marked by name in the subtitles; taken from the wiki.

k: A secretary at the New York Bulletin
A Bulletin secretary secretly informing for Fisk
st: Caldwell hands Ellison the blast list, tips off Fisk after Ellison fires Urich, and is led away from her desk by the FBI.

files.notes: Name said by Ellison in 1x06 ('Caldwell, give me that list') and 1x10. Her tip to Fisk in 1x12 is from the wiki (not in the subtitles). She keeps the Bulletin job as cover, so tm moves to Fisk's Empire when her spying is shown in 1x12. op: Daredevil, whose case against Fisk ends in her arrest; she never meets him.

st: Marlene helps young Wilson hide his father's body, then years later tells Karen and Urich the story before Fisk moves her away.

files.notes: 'Marlene' said by Bill Fisk in 1x08; 'Mrs. Vistain' said repeatedly in 1x10; 'Marlene Vistain' said in full in 3x08. On screen 1x08, 1x10, 1x12. Only her voice is heard in Echo, so no Echo step. No group named on screen: Independent.

add.k: A Rikers inmate and a former Nelson and Murdock client
st: At Rikers, Michael greets Matt warmly, refuses to get him to Vic Jusufi, then punches him to show the Albanians he said nothing.

files.notes: Matt calls him 'Michael' in 3x04 ('What's up, Michael?'); the surname Kemp is not said in the transcript, so n is Michael. On screen only in 3x04. His past work for the Albanians is wiki only, so tm is Independent.

n: An FBI agent on Fisk's detail
add.k: An FBI agent guarding Fisk at the Presidential Hotel
st: Mockta holds Daredevil at gunpoint in the hotel garage, is named as one of Fisk's agents, and dies when Dex attacks the wedding.

files.notes: Name said only in 3x13, in the list of Fisk's agents ('Mockter' in the subtitles; credits spell Mockta). On screen 3x03, 3x06, 3x13. tm moves to Fisk's Empire at 3x13, when he is named among Fisk's operatives.

k: A developer's daughter attacked with her father
A reality star whose father, Rostam, is attacked
st: Daredevil fights off the men kidnapping Neda and her father, and at his hospital bed she tells Karen what happened.

files.notes: Karen says 'his daughter, Neda' of Rostam Kazemi in 3x02. On screen 3x01 and 3x02. Her reality series is not a group: Independent.

add.k: A leader of the Kitchen Irish
st: With Fisk in prison, Nesbitt rallies the Kitchen Irish to retake Hell's Kitchen, until the Punisher shoots him mid-speech.

files.notes: Name said in 2x01 ('Apologies, Mr. Nesbitt'), 2x04 and 2x09. On screen only in 2x01.

n: An FBI agent on Fisk's detail
add.k: An FBI agent guarding Fisk at the Presidential Hotel
st: O'Connor guards Fisk's hotel, joins his corrupt agents, and mans the wedding cameras until Daredevil beats him and he is arrested.

files.notes: Name said only in 3x13, in the list of Fisk's agents. On screen 3x03, 3x06, 3x09, 3x13 per wiki. tm moves to Fisk's Empire at 3x09, where Hattley gathers the agents Fisk has turned.

add.k: Karen's father, who runs the family diner
st: Paxton tells Karen to leave town after Kevin's death, and years later tells her on the phone it is not the time to come home.

files.notes: 'Paxton' said in 3x05 ('Daughter of Paxton and Penelope'). Seen in 3x10 (Karen's past); heard on the phone in 3x07, the latest event in his own story order, so ep is 7. Group: the family diner, the app's Penny's Place.

add.k: An NYU professor and cryptographer paid by the Yakuza
st: Threatened by Daredevil and Elektra, Philip decodes the Yakuza ledger he encrypted and gives up that night's shipment.

files.notes: Elektra calls him 'Philip' and 'Professor' in 2x07 and says he is an NYU professor; Cabroni is not said, so n is Philip. tm uses the app's existing 'New York University' for NYU (his employer); his work for the Yakuza is a one-job hire.

add.k: A Russian mobster working for the Ranskahovs
st: Caught by the masked man, Piotr is arrested, names Wilson Fisk to Blake and Hoffman to cut a deal, and Blake shoots him.

files.notes: Name said in 1x04 and 1x05 ('Piotr, the guy's an idiot'; Blake: 'a dead Chinese illegal, Piotr'). On screen only in 1x05.

st: Prohaszka refuses to share his private bowling game with John Healy, who beats his guards and kills him with a bowling ball.

files.notes: Name said in 1x01, 1x03 and later. On screen only in 1x03. Group: Kitchen Cab, named on screen as his company (1x04 'Prohaszka's holdings in Kitchen Cab'; 1x05 'Owned a majority in Kitchen Cabs'). He never meets a hero; op Daredevil because Nelson and Murdock defend his killer and the case leads to Fisk.

add.k: An FBI agent angling for Fisk's case
st: Ramsey angles for Fisk's case, joins his corrupt agents, keeps police away from Karen's church, and is arrested after the wedding.

files.notes: Name said in 3x02 ('Ramsey and Arinori are kissing Hattley's ass') and 3x13. On screen 3x02, 3x09, 3x13. The radio order about Clinton Church (3x09) is credited to him by the wiki.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Kevin secretly cancels Karen's deferment so she has to leave Fagan Corners for college. When she plans to run off with Todd, Kevin burns Todd's trailer, and he dies when Karen crashes the car as they flee.
stages.whoA: His older sister, who blames herself for his death
stages.whoB: Her younger brother, killed in the crash she caused

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Kevin works the family diner with his father and backs him when Paxton fights with Karen over Todd. After Kevin dies in the crash, Paxton sends Karen away.
stages.whoA: His father, who runs the diner
stages.whoB: His son, who dies in Karen's crash

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Louisa works the Metro-General ER beside Claire through a night of gang casualties. When Hand ninjas storm the ward where Claire is hiding the children, Louisa jumps in front of Claire and is killed, and the hospital's cover-up drives Claire to quit.
stages.whoA: A fellow nurse she dies protecting
stages.whoB: A fellow nurse who dies saving her

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Louisa brushes Foggy off in the overflowing ER when he comes looking for Claire. She later stops him, Matt and Karen from reaching Castle until they explain they are his lawyers.
stages.whoA: A lawyer she keeps out of her way
stages.whoB: A busy nurse who keeps him at bay

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Caldwell works for Ellison at the Bulletin and hands him the list of blast sites, while secretly passing what she hears to Fisk. Ellison watches in shock as the FBI arrests her at her desk.
stages.whoA: Her editor at the Bulletin, whom she spies on
stages.whoB: A secretary who turns out to be Fisk's mole

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Caldwell is Urich's colleague at the Bulletin, and he even hands her his fundraiser piece. When Ellison fires him, she tips off Fisk that Urich may publish online, and Fisk kills him that night.
stages.whoA: A reporter she betrays to Fisk
stages.whoB: A colleague secretly spying for Fisk

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Caldwell is Fisk's mole inside the Bulletin. She tells him about Urich's firing, and she is arrested with the rest of his network.
stages.whoA: The man she secretly informs for
stages.whoB: His mole inside the Bulletin

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Marlene shields young Wilson from his violent father, and when Wilson kills Bill to stop him beating her, she helps him get rid of the body. Years later he hides her in a care home, then moves her out of the city when Karen and Urich find her.
stages.whoA: Her son, whom she protected
stages.whoB: His mother, whom he protects at all costs

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Marlene worries over Bill's loan from Rigoletto and his failed campaign. One night he beats her with his belt, and their son Wilson kills him with a hammer.
stages.whoA: Her abusive husband
stages.whoB: His wife, whom he beats

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Karen visits Marlene at Saint Benezet with Urich and draws her out about her marriages and her son. Marlene lets slip that Wilson killed his father, insisting it was not his fault.
stages.whoA: A kind visitor who asks about her son
stages.whoB: Fisk's mother, who reveals his secret

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Urich comes to Saint Benezet with Karen to find Fisk's mother. When he asks if her son is Wilson Fisk, Marlene recalls the night Wilson killed his father.
stages.whoA: A visitor who asks about Wilson
stages.whoB: Fisk's mother, the source for his story

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Michael thanks Matt for getting sixteen years off his sentence and agrees to keep their talk secret. But when Matt pushes for an introduction to Vic Jusufi, Michael panics and punches him so the Albanians see he gave nothing away.
stages.whoA: The lawyer who cut his sentence
stages.whoB: An old client inside Rikers

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Mockta corners Daredevil in the hotel garage and holds him at gunpoint, blaming him for the agents killed in the ambush, until Daredevil knocks him out. At the wedding, Mockta fires on Daredevil and Dex.
stages.whoA: The masked man he takes for an assassin
stages.whoB: An agent who holds him at gunpoint

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Hattley puts Mockta on Fisk's detail, sends him with Nadeem to the Bulletin, and posts him at the wedding. Nadeem names them both among Fisk's operatives.
stages.whoA: His boss at the FBI
stages.whoB: One of her agents on Fisk's detail

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Mockta rides with Nadeem to the Bulletin to bring in Matt and is knocked down by the fake Daredevil on the way in. Nadeem later names him among the agents working for Fisk.
stages.whoA: The agent who leads the Bulletin raid
stages.whoB: An agent on his Bulletin raid

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Dex, in Daredevil's suit, knocks Mockta down during the Bulletin raid. At the wedding Dex turns on Fisk and kills Mockta with thrown cutlery, then takes his gun.
stages.whoA: The agent who kills him at the wedding
stages.whoB: An agent he kills at the wedding

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Daredevil fights off the men trying to kidnap Neda and her father. He later visits her at the hospital, says the attackers are in police custody, and tells her it was him, not God, who saved them.
stages.whoA: The masked man who saves her and her father
stages.whoB: A woman he saves from kidnappers

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Karen finds Neda at her father's bedside and wins her trust by sharing what happened when her brother died. Neda tells her a man in a black mask saved them, which sends Karen after the Kazemis' hotel deal.
stages.whoA: A reporter she finally talks to
stages.whoB: A source who saw the masked man

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Nesbitt gathers the Kitchen Irish at their club to plan their return to power. Before he can finish his toast, the Punisher shoots him through the window and wipes out the room.
stages.whoA: The gunman who kills him
stages.whoB: An Irish boss he kills mid-speech

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Grotto fetches Nesbitt a drink as the Kitchen Irish gather to hear his speech. Grotto is the only one to survive when the Punisher opens fire.
stages.whoA: A Kitchen Irish underling
stages.whoB: His boss in the Kitchen Irish

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: O'Connor meets Nadeem at the hotel after the ambush and is put on Fisk's detail with him, then rides with him to the Bulletin. When Hattley brings Nadeem in to meet the agents Fisk has turned, O'Connor is among them.
stages.whoA: The agent who leads Fisk's detail
stages.whoB: An agent on Fisk's detail

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Hattley assigns O'Connor to Fisk's detail, sends him to the Bulletin, and posts him on the wedding cameras. Nadeem names them both as Fisk's operatives.
stages.whoA: His boss at the FBI
stages.whoB: One of her corrupt agents

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: O'Connor watches the wedding through the hotel's security cameras for Fisk. Daredevil bursts into the room and beats him.
stages.whoA: The vigilante who beats him at the wedding
stages.whoB: A corrupt agent he takes down

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: O'Connor guards Fisk at the Presidential Hotel and becomes one of his corrupt agents, guarding his wedding. He is arrested along with the rest of Fisk's people.
stages.whoA: The prisoner he guards, then serves
stages.whoB: One of his agents inside the FBI

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Paxton fights with Karen over the failing diner and Todd, and after Kevin dies in the crash he tells her he does not want her there. Years later he picks up her call after the Bulletin attack but says it is not a good time for her to come home.
stages.whoA: His daughter, whom he sends away
stages.whoB: Her father, who turns her away

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Daredevil and Elektra ambush Philip in his apartment, and Daredevil holds him against the cracking window until he agrees to decode the ledger. Daredevil warns him to find better business partners.
stages.whoA: The masked man who forces him to talk
stages.whoB: The cryptographer who decodes the ledger

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Elektra tracks down Philip as the man who encoded the Yakuza ledger. She threatens him until he decodes it, then knocks him out.
stages.whoA: A masked woman who threatens him
stages.whoB: The professor she tracks down

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: The masked man takes down Piotr's crew and demands to know where Vladimir is. Piotr begs for his life, and the police arrive and arrest him.
stages.whoA: The masked man who corners him
stages.whoB: A Russian he interrogates

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Blake mocks Piotr in the interrogation room until Piotr offers the name Wilson Fisk for a deal. Blake uncuffs him, stages a struggle with Hoffman, and shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: The detective who kills him
stages.whoB: A Russian he kills for naming Fisk

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Hoffman questions Piotr with Blake, then lets Blake punch him so they can claim Piotr attacked them. Blake shoots Piotr in the staged struggle.
stages.whoA: A detective in on his murder
stages.whoB: A Russian killed in their staged struggle

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Prohaszka refuses to let Healy join his private game and has his guards throw him out. Healy beats the guards, fights Prohaszka, and kills him with a bowling ball.
stages.whoA: The man who kills him at the bowling alley
stages.whoB: The mobster he kills

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Ramsey and Arinori flatter Hattley to win Fisk's case, and she puts Ramsey on Fisk's guard instead. He becomes one of her agents working for Fisk until they are all exposed.
stages.whoA: His boss at the FBI
stages.whoB: An agent who courts her favor

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Ramsey congratulates Nadeem on the Albanian raid while trying to take Fisk's case from him. He is among the corrupt agents Hattley shows to Nadeem, and Nadeem later names him as one of Fisk's operatives.
stages.whoA: A rival agent for Fisk's case
stages.whoB: An agent competing for Fisk's case

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Ramsey and Dex pick up Fisk from the hotel together as Fisk's agents. When Dex attacks the wedding, he knocks Ramsey out.
stages.whoA: A fellow agent working for Fisk
stages.whoB: A fellow agent on Fisk's side

dropped.why: Never named on screen: neither 'Zyl' nor 'Latimer' is said in the 3x09 or 3x13 transcripts (only Hammer, Starr and Carbone are named), and nothing shown names him; the name comes from the credits.
Never named on screen: 'Lee' or 'Nicholas' is not said in any Daredevil S3 transcript (the wiki notes the name is from the S3 credits); only a subtitle speaker tag reads LEE.
Never named on screen: 'Oscar' is not said in the 1x03 transcript or anywhere else in the series; the name comes from the credits.
Never named on screen as a person: only the firm 'Landman and Zack' is said, and in 1x10 and 1x13 no one calls this man Landman or identifies him; the name comes from the credits.

changes.was: Caldwell hands Urich the blast list, tips off Fisk after Ellison fires Urich, and is led away from her desk by the FBI.
changes.now: Caldwell hands Ellison the blast list, tips off Fisk after Ellison fires Urich, and is led away from her desk by the FBI.
changes.why: Ellison asks for the list ('Caldwell, give me that list') and reads out the blast sites himself; she hands it to Ellison, not Urich.

changes.was: Caldwell works for Ellison at the Bulletin and hands out his assignments, while secretly passing what she hears to Fisk. Ellison watches in shock as the FBI arrests her at her desk.
changes.now: Caldwell works for Ellison at the Bulletin and hands him the list of blast sites, while secretly passing what she hears to Fisk. Ellison watches in shock as the FBI arrests her at her desk.
changes.why: She is never shown handing out Ellison's assignments (he assigns Henricks and Taylor himself); what she does for him on screen is hand him the blast list.
The step's account of Paxton sending Karen away after Kevin's death is only shown in 3x10 (Karen), after the 3x07 phone call; ep 7 would show 3x10 events early.
The stage recaps the diner fight, Kevin's crash and 'I don't want you here, Karen', all shown only in 3x10.

changes.was: "A reality star whose father, Rostam, is attacked"
changes.now: [["A developer's daughter attacked with her father", "Daredevil S3"], ["A reality star whose father, Rostam, is attacked", "Daredevil S3#2"]]
changes.why: Rostam's name and her reality series (Heiresses of Manhattan) are first said in 3x02, but k was unstaged from 3x01 while n is staged to #2.
The stage ends with Karen going after the Kazemis' hotel deal, which happens in 3x03 ('one of these shell companies buys the Presidential Hotel from Kazemi').
Kitchen Cab is named on screen as his company: 'Prohaszka's holdings in Kitchen Cab have been acquired' (1x04) and 'Owned a majority in Kitchen Cabs' (1x05), so it is not just a wiki label.
